officialSources.currentSourceFinding: DisableClickToDo is listed for Windows Insider Preview, for user and device scope. Enabling the policy makes the component and entry points unavailable; disabling or not configuring it makes the feature available, subject to user settings and device context. The feature management page specifies Copilot+ PC or eligible Cloud PC requirements, including 40 TOPS NPU, 16 GB RAM, 8 logical processors and 256 GB storage.

localValidation.repositoryValidation: Passed: 447 operations, 8 groups, 5 profiles and 301 PowerShell files; operation documentation is current.

focusedTest.testName: models Click to Do policy availability with exact user-scope recovery and pending target acceptance

localValidation.preliminaryAttempt: The initial filtered Pester invocation failed before the test body because the optional TestRegistry plugin was denied permission to create HKCU\Software\Pester. Native policy behavior needs a Windows Insider Preview target; visible Click to Do behavior additionally needs eligible Copilot+ or Cloud PC hardware. The prior RIDE-Win11-Test access blocker remains, and no guest was inspected or changed in this batch.
